settings.label: Free shipping from
settings.info: In the shop currency. Drives the bar in the bag drawer; 0 hides it.

settings.label: Free gift from
settings.info: In the shop currency, gift excluded. The gift is added to the bag at this amount and taken out below it; 0 turns it off. Shares one progress bar with free shipping.

settings.label: Gift product
settings.info: Added through the cart with the hidden property _gift. Its price only becomes 0 with an automatic discount in Shopify admin: Discounts > Buy X get Y, Customer spends minimum purchase amount = the amount above, Customer gets 1 of this product at 100% off, max 1 use per order. Without a product, only the theme's demo bag shows the gift.
